name: Draped Table Cover (Full-Color Dye Sublimation, Full Bleed)
descriptionHtml:
Create a polished, professional table display with our Draped Table Cover, designed to deliver full-bleed branding with a classic, elegant look. Ideal for trade shows, vendor booths, corporate events, and promotional displays, this table cover provides a clean presentation while allowing easy access underneath the table.

Printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation, your artwork appears vibrant, sharp, and long-lasting. The draped polyester fabric hangs naturally on all sides, creating a refined appearance that works across a wide range of event environments.

🔹 Key Features

🧵 Display Polyester Fabric – Smooth draped finish for a professional look
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Vivid, fade-resistant graphics
🖼️ Full Bleed Printing – Edge-to-edge custom branding
📏 Multiple Sizes Available – Fits standard 4ft, 6ft, and 8ft tables
⚙️ Easy Setup – Simple drape-on design for fast installation
🧳 Lightweight & Portable – Easy to fold and transport

🔹 Available Sizes

📐 8ft Table: 96"W × 30"H × 30"D
📐 6ft Table: 72"W × 30"H × 30"D
📐 4ft Table: 48"W × 30"H × 24"D

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation (Full Bleed)

🔹 Materials

🧵 Fabric: Display Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, exhibitions, vendor booths, conferences, retail promotions, pop-up shops, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
